aboutParagraphs: My name is Jenny Wilson, and I am currently looking for a job in Frontend Development. I have 3 years of experience working as a Frontend Developer. I have a bachelor’s degree in Electronics and Communication. People find me to be an upbeat, self-motivated team player with excellent communication skills.
I am a dedicated person with a family of four. I enjoy reading, and the knowledge and perspective that my reading gives me have strengthened my teaching skills and presentation abilities.
